import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));

    static int val() throws IOException {
        return Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
    }

    static int[] li() throws IOException {
        String[] line = br.readLine().trim().split(" ");
        int[] arr = new int[line.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
            arr[i] = Integer.parseInt(line[i]);
        }
        return arr;
    }

    static String st() throws IOException {
        return br.readLine().trim();
    }

    static int[] li3() throws IOException {
        String line = br.readLine().trim();
        int[] arr = new int[line.length()];
        for (int i = 0; i < line.length(); i++) {
            arr[i] = line.charAt(i) - '0';
        }
        return arr;
    }

    static int match(int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) return 0;
        else if ((a == 1 && b == 2) || (a == 2 && b == 3) || (a == 3 && b == 1)) return 1;
        else return -1;
    }

    static int give(List<int[]> l1, List<int[]> l2) {
        int ans = 0;
        int[] curr1 = null, curr2 = null;
        while (!l1.isEmpty() || !l2.isEmpty() || curr1 != null || curr2 != null) {
            if (curr1 == null && !l1.isEmpty()) curr1 = l1.remove(l1.size() - 1);
            if (curr2 == null && !l2.isEmpty()) curr2 = l2.remove(l2.size() - 1);
            if (curr1 == null || curr2 == null) return ans;

            ans += Math.max(0, Math.min(curr1[0], curr2[0]) * match(curr1[1], curr2[1]));
            if (curr1[0] < curr2[0]) {
                curr2[0] -= curr1[0];
                curr1 = null;
            } else if (curr1[0] > curr2[0]) {
                curr1[0] -= curr2[0];
                curr2 = null;
            } else {
                curr1 = curr2 = null;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int minimum() throws IOException {
        int n = val();
        int[] rock1 = new int[]{li()[0], 1};
        int[] sci1 = new int[]{li()[1], 2};
        int[] paper1 = new int[]{li()[2], 3};
        int[] rock2 = new int[]{li()[0], 1};
        int[] sci2 = new int[]{li()[1], 2};
        int[] paper2 = new int[]{li()[2], 3};

        List<List<int[]>> l1 = permute(Arrays.asList(rock1, sci1, paper1));
        List<List<int[]>> l2 = permute(Arrays.asList(rock2, sci2, paper2));

        int ans = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (List<int[]> i : l1) {
            List<int[]> mylist1 = new ArrayList<>(i);
            for (List<int[]> j : l2) {
                List<int[]> mylist2 = new ArrayList<>(j);
                ans = Math.min(ans, give(mylist1, mylist2));
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static List<List<int[]>> permute(List<int[]> list) {
        List<List<int[]>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        permuteHelper(list, 0, result);
        return result;
    }

    static void permuteHelper(List<int[]> list, int start, List<List<int[]>> result) {
        if (start == list.size() - 1) {
            result.add(new ArrayList<>(list));
        } else {
            for (int i = start; i < list.size(); i++) {
                Collections.swap(list, start, i);
                permuteHelper(list, start + 1, result);
                Collections.swap(list, start, i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int maximum() throws IOException {
        int n = val();
        int[] a = li();
        int[] b = li();
        return Math.min(a[0], b[1]) + Math.min(a[1], b[2]) + Math.min(a[2], b[0]);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        pw.println(minimum() + " " + maximum());
        pw.flush();
    }
}
